# Lionheart Fixt 0.16.0 - the Crypt

Act 4 has ten maps, 4,206 level parts, 269 live enemy spawners and one quest -- and the quest was
only a name. `Release the Doomed Knights from their torment` had no states at all, so it could
never be entered in the journal, never advanced and never completed; it existed only to be failed
if you killed Jehanne. It has three states now, and pays out when the efreet's wish frees them.

Convince Jehanne with Speech that her Council has been lying to her, walk away and come back, and
she greets you as the monster she met at the gate: the flag recording that conversation was set
nowhere. Her doomed garrison was all placed on the Doomed Plateau, the densest map in the game,
where you arrive already fighting -- one knight now holds a forward post where you meet him before
the shooting starts, and behind the lines there is a camp, built around the man who has kept the
tally since the seals closed.

Four of the ten maps are called "Misc Crypt" and held no conversation, no balloon and no dialogue
tree between them, while carrying 248 generators. They are four fronts now, each with one lever
that moves a two-hundred-year siege, and the act's one real ending reads the result three ways.
66 traps test a thief for the first time. The six claimants to the Lance each get their own answer.

And Jehanne can join you: vanilla wrote her four companion nodes and one of them has ever been
reachable. All four work now -- and in the Burial Chamber the garrison can finally tell whether
she is walking beside the player who is cutting them down.

**Fixt** is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. Almost all of this release is level parts, so it needs a
character who has not yet entered the Crypt. Unplayed -- what you find goes into 0.16.1.
